subject: numeracy
nipun_lo: Grade 1 goal: reads, writes and counts numbers up to 99; this episode covers counting objects and number names up to 20
notes: Count a group of objects by touching each one once and saying one number per object. The last number said tells how many. Number names 1-20 in order, forwards and backwards. Numbers 11-20 as 'ten and some more' (13 is ten and three). Compare two small groups: which has more, which has fewer.
